justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/client/result/VINResultParser.java` and `core/src/test/java/com/google/zxing/client/result/VINParsedResultTestCase.java`. The class is only 209 lines and exposes a single public `parse(Result)` method; the remaining logic is five private static helpers (`checkChecksum`, `vinCharValue`, `vinPositionWeight`, `checkChar`, `modelYear`, `countryCode`) that all support one narrow responsibility: validating and decoding VIN strings. The test file exercises only VIN parsing outcomes, which supports that this class is cohesive rather than insufficiently modularized.
